compatibility.recovery: Refuse unsupported formats before writes; preserve the newer library and restore a compatible pre-upgrade backup into a new directory.

exclusions: Early D0 binaries do not contain the current format and startup recovery safeguards.
An older recorded hash without a retained, independently tested artifact is not a supported rollback build.
Preview packages sharing version 0.1.0 must be distinguished by build date and artifact hashes.
This preview is a retained baseline for future upgrade testing, not proof of compatibility with an actual later release.
